# javaabu/locations

> Countries, states, cities, atolls and islands for Laravel. Seed data for all 249 ISO 3166-1 countries (codes, English and Dhivehi names, calling codes), the 20 administrative atolls and Malé City (letter codes, ISO 3166-2:MV codes, official names), and every island of the Maldives' national island register (feature codes like LD0442, Dhivehi names, categories, coordinates, area), plus optional ISO 3166-2 states. Cascading selects (country → atoll → island, country → state → city) for Blade (<x-locations::island-select>), React (IslandSelect from @javaabu/locations) and javaabu/stencil (IslandSelect::make()->dependsOn()). Admin pages for every type in Blade or Inertia React, with overridable controllers and javaabu/permissions policies. Dhivehi and RTL built in; javaabu/translatable optional.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/locations/.

## Rules

- Never hard-code countries, atolls or islands (arrays, enums, your own seeders). Seed the package's data with `php artisan locations:seed` and use its models: `Country`, `State`, `City`, `Atoll`, `Island` in `Javaabu\Locations\Models`.
- Resolve models with `Locations::islandModel()` (or `Locations::model('island')`) in reusable code, so an app's configured model (`config('locations.models')`) is used. Relate your tables with plain foreign keys to `Locations::table('islands')`.
- Look locations up by code, never by id: `Country::findByCode('MV')`, `Atoll::findByCode('HA')`, `Island::findByCode('LD0442')`. Ids depend on seeding order.
- Names: `name` is English and `dhivehi_name` is Thaana. There is no `name_dv` column; that's javaabu/translatable's naming. Show names with `localizedName()` / `localized_name`, islands in addresses with `formattedName()` (`HA. Dhidhdhoo` / `ހއ. ދިއްދޫ`), and atolls with `optionLabel()` (`HA. Haa Alifu`).
- Atolls belong to the Maldives and have no country column; Malé City is the atoll `MLE`. Use the island scopes `ofAtoll('HA')`, `inhabited()`, `category(IslandCategories::TOURISM)`, `capitals()`, `named()`, `search()`, `ordered()`.
- Register `Route::locationOptions()` for any cascading select, and `Route::locations(['guard' => …])` inside the app's admin group for the admin pages. Nothing registers routes automatically.
- Cascades: Blade `<x-locations::atoll-select child="island_id" />` + `<x-locations::island-select parent="atoll_id" />`; React `<IslandSelect name="island_id" parent="#atoll_id" />`; stencil `IslandSelect::make('island_id')->dependsOn('atoll_id')`. Narrow options with `filters` (`['category' => 'residential']`), not by filtering in the view.
- Authorize with the package's permissions (`view_islands`, `edit_islands`, `delete_islands`, …) and policies; run `php artisan permissions:sync`. Override a policy with `config('permissions.policies')` or `Gate::policy(Island::class, …)`; override a controller with `config('locations.controllers')`.
- Re-seeding only adds missing locations. `locations:seed --update` overwrites names admins edited; never run it on production data without asking.
- Every user-facing string goes through `__('locations::strings.…')` with a Dhivehi line in `lang/dv/strings.php`. Use Thaana in tests of user-facing behaviour.
